svg.title: AgentOS Memory System — classifier-driven dispatch pipeline
svg.desc: A top-down pipeline with up to three classifier calls per query. A user query enters QueryClassifier when the host runs that gate: one LLM call that labels a retrieval tier, after which a T0 query (answerable from context) can skip recall and T1 to T3 go on. MemoryRouter makes one classifier call that labels the query with one of six categories, and its routing table names a backend: the preset's table unless the host passes its own, with a per-category mapping, when the host passes one, replacing the entries it names. A budget policy, when the host sets one, can swap that pick for a cheaper backend, or throw in hard mode. The host's dispatcher runs the executor the host registered for the backend. For canonical-hybrid the drawing shows HybridRetriever: a dense search through MemoryStore.query, which scores each hit on six signals, and a BM25 search over an in-memory index the caller fills, recallTopK times three each; it fuses the two rankings with RRF (0.7 dense, 0.3 sparse, k 60), keeping only traces the dense side returned, blends an optional reranker's score with the composite (0.7 composite, 0.3 rerank) and passes the top recallTopK to the reader. selectReader looks up the reader model from the MemoryRouter's category with no LLM call, and ReadRouter makes one classifier call (none with manualIntent) to pick a read strategy for the grounded answer. Consolidation is separate for each memory facade: ConsolidationLoop serves the Memory facade when consolidate() or memory_reflect runs it, and ConsolidationPipeline serves CognitiveMemoryManager on a timer, hourly by default: a decay sweep, co-activation replay, schema integration and conflict resolution (these three need the memory graph, and schema integration an LLM invoker), spaced repetition, then the mechanisms' consolidation-time hooks. The eight cognitive mechanisms run only when CognitiveMemoryManager is given a cognitiveMechanisms config.
svg.text: AgentOS memory pipeline
Classifier-driven dispatch · up to three classifier calls per query
User query
QueryClassifier · when the host runs the gate
Retrieval tier T0–T3 · one LLM call (QueryRouter's default on OpenAI: gpt-4o-mini)
T0 (answerable from context) → the host can skip recall · T1–T3 go on to recall
MemoryRouter
One classifier call → one of six query categories → the routing table names a backend
the preset's table unless the host passes its own · a per-category mapping replaces the entries it names
minimize-cost (default): multi-session, single-session-preference → observational-memory-v11
the other four categories → canonical-hybrid · a budget policy, when the host sets one, can change the pick
the host's dispatcher runs the executor the host registered for the backend
CANONICAL-HYBRID · EXECUTOR IN THIS DRAWING: HybridRetriever
optional HyDE: a hypothesis replaces the query in both searches
Dense · MemoryStore.query()
embeddings + the six-signal composite score
similarity · strength · recency · mood · graph · importance
Sparse · BM25Index (in memory)
lexical ranks: exact and rare terms
the caller fills it: hybrid.bm25.addDocument()
recallTopK × 3 each (30 at the defaults)
RRF merge · 0.7 dense, 0.3 sparse, k = 60
keeps only traces the dense side returned
Optional reranker · Cohere rerank-v3.5 in the benchmark runs
score = 0.7 × composite + 0.3 × rerank score · without one, the RRF order stands
top recallTopK (10) to the reader
selectReader(category, preset)
Picks the reader model · a table lookup over the MemoryRouter's category · no LLM call
min-cost-best-cat-2026-04-28: temporal-reasoning, single-session-user → gpt-4o · the rest → gpt-5-mini
ReadRouter
Picks the read strategy · one classifier call (none with manualIntent) → one of five intents
the precise-fact preset (the default) maps them to four strategies:
single-call · two-call-extract-answer · scratchpad-then-answer · commit-vs-abstain
Grounded answer
CONSOLIDATION · EACH MEMORY FACADE HAS ITS OWN
ConsolidationLoop · Memory facade
runs when consolidate() or the memory_reflect tool calls it
with selfImprove on (the default) · no timer of its own
prune → merge → strengthen → derive → compact → re-index
derive needs an LLM invoker, which the facade does not pass
ConsolidationPipeline · CognitiveMemoryManager
hourly by default · built with a consolidation config or a graph
decay sweep → co-activation replay → schema integration → conflicts
→ spaced repetition → consolidation-time mechanisms
replay, schemas and conflicts need the graph; schemas also an LLM invoker
The eight cognitive mechanisms run only when CognitiveMemoryManager is given a cognitiveMechanisms config.
